facts.text: The opening scene, before the robbery
facts.why: Printed under Coffee shop stack. In the opening scene the robbers only drink coffee. Vincent eats pancakes and bacon in the final diner scene, with Jules.
facts.fix: Vincent's pancakes, before Honey Bunny stands up

facts.text: the opening scene at the diner, before the robbery
facts.why: Same issue, for the Diner pancakes dish. Pancakes belong to Vincent in the closing diner scene, not the opening one.
facts.fix: Vincent's pancakes at the diner before the robbery

facts.why: Sources describe Marilyn Monroe as a waitress in Slim's, not a hostess. Vincent points her out as a waitress dressed as Marilyn.

vibe.verdict: A fan pleasing Jack Rabbit Slim's with the right orders, only the pancake note and the hostess title slip.
missing: Royale with Cheese (Vincent and Jules in the car)
Jules taking a bite of Brett's burger, 'tasty burger' (Brett's flat)
Fabienne's blueberry pancakes and blueberry pie (the motel)
Butch's pastries in the toaster (the motel)
ideas: Swap 'Mamie's devilled eggs' for Mia's Durwood Kirby burger (one source spells it Derwood).
Swap the 'Coffee shop stack' note for 'Vincent's pancakes. Jules passes on the bacon.'
Swap 'Slim's fries' for 'Royale with Cheese' and keep the Holland mayo joke on the note.
